rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: Landlords in Boston must give tenants a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as any Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease, and must also report the notice to the City using an online portal.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to all landlords planning to end a tenancy agreement in Boston.
rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires ALL LANDLORDS planning to end a tenancy agreement to provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources.
